claims: The Artemis II mission is scheduled to splash down in the Pacific Ocean off the coast of San Diego, California.
The Artemis II mission is scheduled to splash down on Friday, April 10, 2026.
The Artemis II mission is scheduled to splash down at approximately 8:07 p.m. EDT (5:07 p.m. PDT).
The Artemis II crew will re-enter Earth's atmosphere at 7:53 p.m. EDT.
The Artemis II mission is a 10-day mission around the Moon.
Artemis II service module separation is scheduled at 7:33 p.m. EDT on April 10, 2026.
Artemis II re-entry into Earth's atmosphere is scheduled at 7:53 p.m. EDT on April 10, 2026.
Artemis II splashdown in the Pacific Ocean is scheduled at 8:07 p.m. EDT on April 10, 2026.
The Artemis II mission brings back astronauts Reid Wiseman, Victor Glover, Christina Koch, and Jeremy Hansen.
The Artemis II astronauts orbited the Moon.
